author: Jongh
body:
I access the in-game player list (tab key) a lot, and I find that Avicus has it as simply a random list of all players on the server, compared to OCN where the two teams are in two nice lists with observers down on the bottom, and color coded to top it off.

 I think Avicus should implement this, the player list helps me a lot when just seeing who/how many on each team, who's observing, etc. Also in the scrim servers it's annoying to have to count the players on each team because it's completely random, when if you had it in a nice little list it would be easy to compare.
